text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shared our plans for the upcoming 
promotional live show and training for the 
Grand Live with Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list:
No, it's not an order, I'm just asking for 
your advice.
No, it's not an order, just a discussion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello said, "The Grand Live is a 
concert meant for expressing gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why, especially for 
Mihono Bourbon, I wanted her to take the 
stage through her own will and 
feelings—not just because of an order."
choice_data_list:
You can just observe first, and decide 
after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the day comes when Mihono Bourbon 
wishes to participate of her own accord... 
we'll have her join us on stage then.
